|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Conquest (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-conquest_ai8ba25cd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/conquest_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/conquest_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Conquest”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Conquest (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2023<ref name="img-conquest_ai69b48d5">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/conquest_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/69b48d5906370abc197be89533853ee63ff8cb86 commit 69b48d5] (19 February 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/conquest_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the lore “Millemium Falcon” → “Millennium Falcon” (typo fixed); the credit “@ Artstation” → “@ ArtStation”; the copyright line on the right edge “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; the Players Committee logo (“SWCCG Players Committee”) now prints at bottom right, left of “(AI)”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image.
